title: kOA Resource Envelope
description: Validates a kOA resource envelope for a profile, node, workspace, component, service instance, job, worker, process group, capability, queue, or storage resource. The envelope declares reservations, limits, quotas, concurrency, queues, scheduling, activation, degradation, recovery, enforcement, observability, receipts, integrity, and validation. It is enforced by the Resource Governor or an equivalent declared backend and has no authorization, consent, disclosure, publication, or machine-privilege effect.
$comment: Cross-object and arithmetic checks are performed by docs/tools/validate_docs.py. The validator resolves profile, component, workspace, node, job, parent-envelope, pool, backend, test, evidence, and receipt references; proves that reservations do not exceed limits; proves that soft limits do not exceed hard limits; validates percentage ordering; checks that child reservations fit parent or pool capacity; rejects cycles; validates unit consistency; verifies that enforcement backends support every declared resource; verifies task-activation and idle-shutdown behavior; ensures degradation never creates policy authority; and confirms that profile and component contracts remain the owners of resource values and capability requirements.

priority.description: Zero is lowest priority and one hundred is highest.
